title: Hosted inference peak runway curves (15min sensitivity) 2026Q3
summary: This sheet contains short-window (15-minute bucket) peak load projections and headroom runway curves for the Hosted API. Purpose: decide short-duration pre-warm and safety buffer policies per region and GPU family for Q3 2026 operational runbooks.
objectives: 1) Produce 15m and 60m peak curves with 50/90/99 percentiles by region and model-class. 2) Recommend a per-pool reserve fraction and prewarm trigger thresholds. 3) Call out cost vs latency trade-offs for burst-mitigation options.
assumptions:
- Historical telemetry: last 12 months of token/sec from BigQuery table hosted.events_tokens_agg_15m.
- Model mix: 40% small-gen, 45% dense-chat, 15% embedding-heavy.
- GPU families available: A100-80GB (prod pools), H100 (spot-eligible pools), T4 for low-cost embeddings.
- Autoscaler reaction times: warm-up 90s for A100, 150s for H100 when cold.
- Traffic growth scenarios: conservative +8% q/q, baseline +18% q/q, aggressive +35% q/q for marketing-driven features.
peak_projections_15min: Scenario: Baseline (18% q/q) | Region: us-west1 | Model mix as-assumed | 15m-90pctl tokens/sec: 420k | QPS equivalent: 1.9k | GPUs needed (A100): 42 | Headroom target (recommended): 20%
Scenario: Aggressive marketing burst (+35% q/q) | Region: us-east1 | 15m-99pctl tokens/sec: 1.1M | QPS: 5.0k | GPUs needed (A100): 110 | Immediate fallback: route low-priority embeddings to T4 pools

Scenario: Microburst (6x baseline for 3 consecutive 15m buckets) | Region: eu-west1 | 15m peak tokens/sec: 2.6M | QPS: 11.8k | GPUs needed: 260 across AZs | Recommended emergency throttle policy: token-based shedding with 10% first-pass reduction

Scenario: Low-latency-optimized traffic (dense-chat heavy) | Region: ap-northeast1 | 15m-95pctl tokens/sec: 310k | QPS: 1.4k | GPUs needed (H100 preferred): 35 | Prewarm threshold: sustained 15m growth > 25%
regional_breakdown_notes:
- us-west1: steady baseline, quick autoscaler; maintain 15% reserved pool.
- us-east1: higher marketing exposure; recommend 25% reserve + scheduled prewarm windows for US business hours.
- eu-west1: multi-AZ distribution to meet regulatory fallbacks; 18% reserve.
- ap-northeast1: limited H100 capacity; prefer routing non-latency critical embeddings to central pools in us-west1 with egress consideration.
scaling_policy_recommendation:
1) Two-tier reserve: hot reserve (warmed, full KV cache) sized for 15m-90pctl spike per region; cold reserve (cold VMs that can spin up in 150-300s) sized for delta to 99pctl.
2) Prewarm triggers: sustained 15m window growth >20% over rolling 60m OR QPS derivative crossing 2x baseline -> prewarm hot reserve up to configured cap.
3) Shedding policy: non-critical embeddings and experimental routes are eligible for graceful degrade when utilization >92% for >3 consecutive 15m buckets.
4) Fallback routing: route to lower-cost quantized variants if latency SLO allows, otherwise fallback to cross-region pools with cost-offset tags.
safety_buffer_heuristics: Static buffer: keep minimum 15% of regional pool unallocated for 15m transient spikes
Dynamic buffer: for pools with high burstiness score (>0.6), increase buffer to 25% and enable fast prewarm
Economic buffer: if projected hourly cost of reserve > $X (budget threshold), prefer quantized fallback over extra reserve
Cross-region buffer: maintain 5% cross-region capacity for regulatory-safe models where allowed
cost_vs_latency_tradeoffs:
- Reserving extra A100 slots reduces cold-start failures but increases hourly committed spend.
- Quantized model fallbacks lower GPU footprint by ~40% at the expense of small quality regressions; use for low-SLA embedding routes.
- Cross-region routing adds network egress latency (~30-70ms) but can be cheaper than keeping underutilized dedicated pools in low-demand regions.
operational_runbook_snippets: If 15m token/sec crosses 90pctl and hot reserve < recommended -> trigger canary prewarm job and page on-call SRE
If autoscaler fails to supply GPU within warm-up SLA -> escalate to infra-leads and flip automatic fallback routing to quantized variants
When projected 99pctl exceeds 80% of cluster capacity -> create procurement ticket for temporary capacity and notify capacity-ops
